items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 15 at 12:22PM AKDT until August 15 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures in the lower 80s expected today.

* WHERE...Haines Borough and Klukwan and Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.areas: Haines Borough and Klukwan; Prince of Wales Island
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles under any
circumstances as vehicle interiors can reach extreme temperatures in
as little as 10 minutes.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 15 at 12:46AM AKDT until August 18 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Sunday to midnight AKDT Monday Night.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Wind gusts will be strongest Sunday night into
Monday.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
